reviews.title: Awesome Point of Sale
reviews.review: Our overall experience with TeeQuest has been very positive. We would highly recommend them to every golf course that wants a smooth operation, awesome customer support, and a clean look for the point of sale system.

reviews.title: TeeQuest - Recommend for Golf Clubs
reviews.review: Customer service has consistently been responsive and supportive, and I have built an excellent working relationship with the team. While no program is without flaws, TeeQuest enables our Club to operate seamlessly at a multimillion-dollar level. When the occasional issue arises, I know exactly who to contact and can rely on their team to provide a timely solution.
reviews.pros: TeeQuest offers a comprehensive suite of functions within an intuitive platform that can be learned quickly and efficiently. The teesheet is straightforward and user-friendly, with a wide range of features available to customize and optimize operations.
reviews.cons: While I use TeeQuest for Food & Beverage operations, the platform would be even more effective if it incorporated POS-style functions similar to systems like Toast or Cake.

reviews.title: Shirkey Golf Course TeeQuest review
reviews.review: Awesome. Every time I need something the team at teequest hooks me up. They solve virtually any problem I have and make it super easy to ask questions and figure problems out.
reviews.pros: The service is great. [sensitive content hidden] always take care of me when I can’t figure it out. Our employees love it.
reviews.cons: Sometimes the system can be buggy but usually I just need to refresh.

switched_from.reason: Our board felt that golf now was not user friendly.

reviews.title: Royal Hylands
reviews.review: We have used tee quest for the past two years and have been satisfied.
reviews.pros: Ease of use. Ability run our own specials. Customer service.
reviews.cons: Not being able to remote from a n offsite computer as a manager. Inventory procedures.
reviews.reason_for_choosing: Pricing and customer service. And liked the features better for marketing and day to day management.

reviews.title: The best business partner is TeeQuest!
reviews.review: TeeQuest employees are extremely responsive to any issues or problems I need solved, usually regarding a customer who makes an error with a on-line tee time. The POS and Tee sheet are very easy to use. The reporting capabilities seem endless! I am in a very rural area with limited internet choices. Having the ability to operate the tee sheet and cash only POS is a bonus. The gift card program that shows the customer how much they have remaining on their balance is a nice feature. Overall I am very satisfied with the TeeQuest customer service and capabilities of the POS and Tee Sheet.
reviews.pros: The POS and Tee Sheet are very easy to navigate. The Tee Sheet and web-sight tee times work hand in hand and allow the public and members to make on line tee times.
reviews.cons: I would like to be able to show when we squeeze in an extra tee time. I would like the customer to be able to add a tip immediately on the credit card terminal.
reviews.reason_for_choosing: [sensitive content hidden] did an outstanding presentation with the advantages of going with TeeQuest.

switched_from.reason: Their system was too expensive. The amount of money they “stole” from my golf course was outrageous!

reviews.title: Rating on Tee Quest
reviews.review: My over all experience is really good. I have guys I can call to help if I need them
reviews.pros: That its easy to use and I have 2 great guys to call if I cant get it figured out.
reviews.cons: every now and again my icons will disappear

reviews.title: TeeQuest Solutions
reviews.review: TeeQuest has been an outstanding POS/Tee System for our facility. Support staff is attentive to questions and any issues that we may encounter.
reviews.pros: Very user-friendly (especially when training a new employee) and the ability to speak with an actual person in a timely manner when there is a problem or question. Definitely a better system to work with than GolfNow
reviews.cons: Wish there was a way for the system to automatically calculate a credit card fee when a CC is used for green fee/merchandise purchases.
reviews.reason_for_choosing: User-friendly, customer support offered by TeeQuest

switched_from.reason: Tech Support, Ease of Use, was able to eliminate "Hot Deals" that GolfNow loves to market

reviews.title: TeeQuest, Your #1 Golf Course POS Solution
reviews.review: I am absolutely thrilled with TeeQuest and the staff is so easy to work with. They ask for feedback and implement suggestions.
reviews.pros: TeeQuest is the easiest and most simple point-of-sale system I have ever used at a golf course. The simplistic approach makes transactions a breeze and the customer support is unmatched.
reviews.cons: TeeQuest has very few flaws... the only thing that could be improved is its tablet application.

reviews.title: Review of TeeQuest POS System
reviews.review: From the time I called for information until the actual installation and training, everyone has been very helpful and professional. During the training period they took their time explaining all aspects of the system and answered any questions that I had.
reviews.pros: The program is flexible and user friendly. It is fast and everything is at your fingertips. The management team imported all my previous data. There are useful reports. My customers can book 24/7 with the on-line booking engine. I find that I am spending less time on I T issues and more time on my customers. I find that this program provides the best service for me and my customers.
reviews.cons: You need to manually add credit card fees to this system - they aren't configures automatically.

switched_from.reason: Losing to much revenue is terms of tee times I needed to give them.

reviewer.name: Fred I.
reviewer.title: Assistant Golf Course Manager and Tournament Director

reviews.title: Best POS I've used.
reviews.review: Overall experience has been great. I would recommend this POS system to anyone. You don't have to be a rocket scientist to use it.
reviews.pros: Easy and simple. Configurable. Easy to train new employees on the system.
reviews.cons: Any issues in the beginning were addressed and rectified.

reviews.title: Tee Quest
reviews.review: The experience with Tee Quest is Excellent.
reviews.pros: Software applicability at the time of a purchase is generally well determined. Support is the greatest need once the decision to purchase a software system. The support by Tee Quest has been outstanding.
reviews.cons: Most all software systems are not ideal in every aspect. Tee Quest's system like others does not offer all the services one might desire for an expanding golf related business. We think highly enough of Tee Quest that what one might suggest is a shortcoming in an area of their system is far surpassed by the merits of their overall product applicability generally and their support specifically.
reviews.reason_for_choosing: The product simply was better and more in line with our needs. Being small enough to be responsive but large enough to be relevant is important to us.

reviews.title: Saving
reviews.pros: User friendly for all of employees and managers much quicker to check in golfers
reviews.cons: I find that the tee sheet and system works very well for what I am doing give me a year of using it and I will come up with something that it needs but right now everything is working just fine

reviews.title: Redfield review
reviews.review: We've been very happy so far with teequest
reviews.pros: I like having control over the website and online booking rates
reviews.cons: There's nothing that i would say i like the "least". checking in golfers takes a few extra steps but it's still pretty quick

reviews.title: TeeQuest Review
reviews.review: My experience has been very good! No problems at all!
reviews.pros: Everything is pretty straight forward! It is very difficult to make a mistake using this software! Very easy to learn
reviews.cons: The only complaint I have is I would like for there to be a "non member" feature. We have a lot of returning public play & it makes it easier to have them already in the system so we do not have to keep asking for there name & phone number!
reviews.reason_for_choosing: Very easy to learn system for a low price!

reviews.title: Easy Update
reviews.review: From the initial sales conversation to installation was exactly as as advertised.
reviews.pros: The transition from our old system to this was very easy. The learning curve for the staff was very minimal. The reports are very simple to retieve and use.
reviews.cons: I would like to see a phone app so I can monitor the tee sheet from out on the course.
reviews.reason_for_choosing: A smaller company and hopefully better product support.

reviews.title: Teequest is a solid product
reviews.review: The Teequest team is a dedicated staff that is focused on helping your golf course improve its bottom line and train your staff for success. Their personal touch with the set up process and customer support is refreshing! They are very punctual and after being with a bigger company their personal touch and willingness to solve the problem quickly is a huge change compared to the big company experience that we had in the past when it went often take days and multiple ticket numbers to fix an issue. Specifically, [SENSITIVE CONTENT] is simply awesome and a huge help in any endeavor with the system. He continues to go above and beyond fixing the problem and then proactively helping us manage or strategize to eliminate future issues.
reviews.pros: The customer service is outstanding with a punctual and dedicated staff. the ease-of-use is great for us too being an operation that has many part time employees they love the set up of the system and intuitive design.
reviews.cons: It would be nice to be able to check in on the tee sheet and do some minor adjustments from my mobile phone. At the present time I need to use an outside source to do a remote login to my computer for any adjustments away from the golf course.
reviews.reason_for_choosing: Personal touch, For us the ability to talk to a physical person on the phone quickly to help solve problems or to be trained on different parts of the system was highly critical and teequest has delivered every time. Also they continue to look for feedback to improve their system personally reaching out and doing quarterly check-in’s. They are truly committed to helping your golf course improve the bottom line, communicate better with customers and provide a great online experience. I highly recommend Teequest to every golf course and especially smaller public courses looking for a clean professional presentation at a great price!

switched_from.reason: We wanted to take control of our T sheet and have more of a personal touch when it came to organizing our golf course and strategizing about how we could create a better customer experience. Also course specials with golf now often lead to individual golfers coming in and wanting to play by themselves i’ll course specials for the new system include at least two golfers at a time eliminating conflict at the register with pairing up on carts.

reviews.title: TeeQuest Golf Software
reviews.review: VERY VERY GOOD - They could not have more helpful. 10 out of 10.
reviews.pros: Very simple and easy for the staff to use. East to get from the Tee Sheet to the POS. Also to enter new Members and capture information. Great reports as well. Support is AWESOME as well.
reviews.cons: Nothing really. We are unique 27 hole golf course and the team at TeeQuest was very accommodating to our needs.
reviews.reason_for_choosing: Great reviews for its current customers.

switched_from.reason: Poor service. Too many issues with overbooking or not booked at all. Paying way too much with Hot deals and felt like I was competing with GolfNow & I thought they were supposed to be my partner. Not my competition.

reviews.title: Top Notch Support
reviews.review: This is a great POS system and tee sheet management software backed by excellent support. The best part is getting away from GolfNow. We control our tee time sales again!
reviews.pros: The software is great, but the support is the best thing. Very responsive and easy to get questions answered.
reviews.cons: Linking in beverage cart sales with the system would improve sales tracking. That process is promised for next year.
reviews.reason_for_choosing: Smaller, more responsive company; good reviews from other golf courses; and a great product.

reviews.title: TeeQuest Review
reviews.review: Been great to work with! Top notch customer service. In person training was easy to pick up.
reviews.pros: TouchScreen, transition from tee sheet to POS. Reports
reviews.cons: This may be available...going to a portable option for beverage cars/outside sales

reviews.title: Beech Creek Golf Club TeeQuest Review
reviews.pros: We really enjoy the freedom from the trade times we had with our last POS/Tee Sheet system. We no longer are stuck discounting our tee times below what we want and essentially devaluing our product. What's even better is that the functionality of the software is great. It was an easy transition to TeeQuest and we are very happy with the overall performance of the product.
reviews.cons: One of the only problems we have had is that it is a little tricky to ring up tournaments/outings and then pay out gift certificates with a portion of the money.

reviews.title: So many features all in one software. TeeQuest does everything we need it to. Literally everything.
reviews.review: Absolutely fantastic and easy to use software for managing golf courses.
reviews.pros: We absolutely love tee quest. We love how easy it is to use. Managing tee times in now easier than ever. We also manage inventory and our food and beverage supply easily. It can even do so much more if you need it to!
reviews.cons: It would be a crime to say anything wrong about this software. We genuinely enjoy using it and we have never been let down.

reviews.title: Outstanding point of sale solution for golf courses, low cost, great customer service.
reviews.pros: I love the fact that this small business is providing a point of sale solution and online tee sheet that actually helps golf courses. The product is incredibly reliable and easy to use.
reviews.cons: The website that TeeQuest provides leaves far more to be desired. It feels a bit aged in terms of web development and does not allow customizability on the golf course side.

reviews.title: Having used over a dozen POS systems, we can say with confidence this is the best and were happy.
reviews.review: Business operations have become much easier, fast, more efficient and have result in thousands saved.
reviews.pros: The tee sheet is easy to run specials on and make organizing tournament days and times very easy. The POS side is very user friendly and easy to train staff. The inventory keeping makes reordering and inventory analysis as easy as it gets so we always have the right items and have them in stock. This system does not only do everything we need it to and more, but it does it very easily and saves the business a lot of money by saving a lot of time.
reviews.cons: Cannot book multiple tee times at once. Would like to have an option the tee time confirmations are sent.

reviews.title: If you are looking for a full service provider then TeeQuest is your answer.
reviews.pros: I have been working with TeeQuest for the past 10 years and feel more like a partner than customer. The staff at TeeQuest is constantly concerned with feedback and ways that they can improve the overall TQ experience. The support staff is second to none and is always available during those difficult course hours.
reviews.cons: They don't offer a solution for managing tournaments at this time. We use a 3rd party for that though.

reviews.title: Thank you TeeQuest, I could not be as successful at my job without you.
reviews.pros: TeeQuest has simplified our process of running the tee sheet, tracking rounds and taking physical inventory. Their team is always available to assist us when we have any problems or questions. The training that they provided made it very easy for me to then train my staff and get them to feel comfortable with the system quickly. I love the fact that you can take the Tee Sheet to an offline mode if we lose our internet connection.

reviews.title: A great company!
reviews.pros: We have been with TeeQuest since 2007 and they have been a joy to work with. If problems or questions ever arise with hardware, software, or the process of booking times, they are immediately responsive.

reviews.title: We have used several other POS & Tee Sheet vendors but TeeQuest is the best fit for our 7 courses.
reviews.review: The software has helped our facilities to have a great online presence selling a lot of course special tee times and online store certificates.
reviews.pros: We have been very pleased with how easy the system is to use. Our staff warmed up to TeeQuest right away. From the management end, TeeQuest answered all of our questions, took our comments and suggestions for how we manage our operations, and made some technical changes that really helped us through the transition.
reviews.cons: We are currently not able to do refunds onto Member Charge accounts but I have been told that is going to be fixed in the next release which is in a couple of weeks.

reviews.title: Great company and great software!
reviews.pros: Managing our 36 hole facility with TeeQuest is straightforward. Both our courses have a web presence and generate revenue from online bookings, which frees my staff to focus on serving customers in the proshop.
reviews.cons: We had several things about the software that needed fixed early on but those have all been rectified over time. It really does everything we need and don't really have any cons at the moment.

reviews.title: Overall I am very pleased with the ease of use for my staff.
reviews.pros: The POS is incredibly simplified for my staff, allowing them the confidence to perform their jobs quickly and efficiently. Being able to drop tee times at random times allows me the opportunity to maximize my revenues and give customers the best chance to play our course.
reviews.cons: When a customer is booking online and they do not actually book the time, it leaves the time unavailable for an extended period of time and doesn't let us reserve the tee times for another customer.

vendor_response.text: Alec, we hold that tee time for the customer online for 10 minutes (by design) so someone else (who may be a faster at typing) does not come in and book it out from under them. If they do not complete the transaction within 10 minutes we open it back up to everyone.

reviews.title: Great people to work with! Love working with TeeQuest.
reviews.review: We came from an unreliable inconsistent software that was web-based. This software is tremendously more reliable.
reviews.pros: -Very user friendly -straight-forward functions -meets my eye well -support staff is fast and effective
reviews.cons: -Some basic functions are missing -A few more basic capabilities regarding member charging and the tee sheet would be nice

vendor_response.text: Chris, we are happy to report that we have added many of the tee sheet functions that we have spoken about and the functionality do a refund on a members AR account.

reviews.title: TeeQuest Solutions Review
reviews.review: We have been extremely pleased with the transition to TeeQuest at our facilities. From the pre-planning to the install and training, the implementation of the software was the easiest and most efficient that we have experienced. Another major benefit is the ease that our employees have had in learning and using the software.
